whatItDoes: Generates TypeScript interfaces, Go structs with json tags, Python dataclasses, Java classes, Rust structs, and C# classes from a single JSON sample. Infers nested objects, arrays, nullable fields, and emits code ready to paste.
whyItExists: Turning an API response into types by hand is tedious and error-prone. One sample can scaffold all target languages at once, locally without sending your payload to a server.
whoShouldUse: Full-stack developers scaffolding SDKs, mobile devs needing models from an endpoint, and anyone converting a webhook sample into typed code.
useCases: Paste a user API response → Generate TypeScript User + Address interfaces
Generate Go structs with `json:"field"` tags for a backend handler
Create Python dataclasses with Optional for nullable API fields
instructions: Paste JSON in the left pane, pick a language from the select, optionally set the root name.
The code updates live as you type, with nested types and array item types inferred from the first element.
Copy the code (data-testid) or download as a file. One sample is heuristic — validate with JSON Schema for production.
examples: Input: {"user": {"name": "Ada", "age": 30}, "tags": ["dev"]} → TypeScript: interface User {name: string; age: number;} interface Root {user: User; tags: string[];}
Input: same → Go: type User struct { Name string `json:"name"` ... }
bestPractices: Provide a representative sample with all optional fields present (null for optional) so nullable is inferred
Rename Root to your domain name after generation
Validate generated types with JSON Schema for arrays of heterogeneous items
commonMistakes: Feeding a single sample and expecting schema guarantees — one sample is not a schema; add missing fields manually
Ignoring nulls — nulls become Optional/pointers; remove if the field is always present
Assuming array item types from empty arrays — empty arrays default to any[]/interface{}
faq: Is the JSON uploaded? No — generation is pure JS in your browser. Samples never leave your device.
Does it support nested arrays? Yes — it recurses and creates item types for arrays of objects.
Can I change the root name? Yes — edit the Root field before copying.
features: 6 languages in one UI with live preview
